text: {"name": "mac_build_tx_data_frame_header", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Builds a 24-byte IEEE 802.11 To-DS data frame header, copying AP/station 48-bit MAC addresses into addr1/addr2/addr3 and writing an incremented TX sequence number shifted into the sequence-control field.", "subsystem": "mac", "var_renames": {"a1": "frame_hdr", "v3": "seq_ctx", "v4": "tx_seq", "v5": "ap_addr_upper", "v6": "ap_addr_low", "v7": "sta_addr_upper"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "frame_control (Data frame, To DS)"}, {"offset": 2, "meaning": "duration (fixed value 1)"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "addr1/RA (AP/BSSID MAC)"}, {"offset": 10, "meaning": "addr2/TA (station MAC)"}, {"offset": 16, "meaning": "addr3/BSSID (AP MAC)"}, {"offset": 22, "meaning": "sequence_control (tx sequence number << 4)"}]}
